result.message: Reviewed the optimized candidate (sha256 b62c3b66…, round 2) against the supplied catalog definition, oracle, correctness/timing workloads, ledger, and downstream preflight/evaluate evidence. The candidate is a self-contained Triton implementation of moe_sum_reduce (contiguous [T, top_k, H] -> [T, H], fp32 accumulation, scale-then-cast), matches the declared ABI (two positional arguments, one new tensor output, no mutation/alias), never calls the reference or any torch.ops/ATen fallback, does no host synchronization and mutates no environment state. Tile selection, the shape-keyed config cache, and the num_tokens>512 stage heuristic are generic tuning, not test-specific shape hard-coding; the EVEN path is safe because _make_config always selects block sizes that exactly divide the dimensions. Math semantics match the independent oracle (abs/rel error 0.0 in both optimize rounds and the retest). No P0 conversion, circularity, ABI, or benchmark-target defects were found. Remaining items are advisory: correctness workloads do not cover the multi-row/7168-hidden benchmark shapes, the non-EVEN masked branch is unreachable dead code, and non-contiguous inputs are handled by a full .contiguous() copy. Note that the review_tests stage evidence records an orchestration-recorded SKIPPED_EXPLICIT test-contract review (review.json), so no separate test-contract acceptance exists for this subject; this review is limited to the candidate code and supplied measurement evidence.
